Mum: What jobs did your friends have?
Sam: Leo checked the bags below the tables.
Mum: Did Eva collect the notebooks?
Sam: No. Eva handed out the notebooks.
Mum: What about Jo?
Sam: Jo showed new pupils around.
Mum: And Ruby?
Sam: Ruby cleaned the art tables after the lesson.
Mum: What did Ben do?
Sam: Ben collected the question cards for the teacher.
